reviews.t: Cute for Rainbow Dash but Uncomfortable
reviews.x: The wig straight out of the bag is very flat and thin as well. I was a bit disappointed not in the coloring or styling but just the overall lack of hair haha. It’s not too terrible for an $18 wig, but no one wants a wig with visible wefts. I crimped the wig because of this, so I can say that it’s definitely heat resistant (crimped on the highest heat setting), and after that it was very easy to shape and style using steam (also very hot). Minimal cutting was required, but I thinned out the ends

Its longer than I thought it would be, and after reading previous reviews, its thicker as well. I'm not sure what other people expect out of a cheap wig. The cap is a nice ventilated tan mesh and if has tightening straps at the nape. I really like the texture of this wig, I've had some that would knot up in a nasty way after 15 minutes of wear. Bought it for boyfriends Halloween costume it was perfect! When we received it he kept getting hair in his face because of the way the wig has a part in the center but thanfully we ordered ahead and received on time so i used bobby pins to part hair and keep in place for about a week untill we needed it, once pins were removed hair stayed out of face more.
I cut the bangs- a lot! Styled with my flat iron on 275 then added some dry shampoo. So nice foe 13 dollars.
Just perfect with my costume, feels great and looks great, also y did a different hairstyle and it was better. Delivery in just 2 days.
Good quality and came faster than expected.. Great for twilight sparkle cosplay.
Super cute! Bought it for my 3 and 5 year old daughters.

reviews.t: She's 5 and it fit her great. There is elastic in it which makes it ...
reviews.x: Got this for my daughter to be rainbow dash for halloween.  She's 5 and it fit her great.  There is elastic in it which makes it fit her and I tried it on and it fit me as well.  It is a really full wig and the "hair" is really soft. Not rough and scratchy that you find in most cheap wigs.  Definitely pleasantly surprised.  Would buy again and would recommend to friends.

reviews.t: It's good for what I paid for!
reviews.x: I did like this wig for my Rainbow Dash cosplay but I will make a pros and cons list for others looking to buy it. (Even though there are cons the issues are easily fixable). Pros: Under $20, pretty easy to style, a fun colorful wig, great for a Rainbow Dash cosplay! Cons: A little thin so teasing/crimping may be necessary, mine came with a bump in the center but honestly really easy to smooth out with a flat iron, be aware of the lack of orange in the back of the wig. I'll be adding orange hair

Really loved this set, especially for the price. I needed a quick way to be Rainbow Dash for my nieces birthday. I wasn't even expecting a pretty good quality wig but it definitely was. I was pretty impressed. The only thing that would have kicked it up a notch would have been more hair towards the bottom since it is pretty thin towards the bottom. But it's vibrant and did the job.

reviews.t: I got this for my son who is obsessed with ...
reviews.x: I got this for my son who is obsessed with my little pony.  The tail is basically a hair clip with synthetic hair glued to it.  The wig tends to shed a bit but that's normal for synthetic hair.  The wig had inner straps to tighten it to different head sizes.  Overall a decent little set for play time.
I ordered this for my daughter’s Rainbow Dash Halloween costume.  It was the perfect accessory - she loved it and it looked adorable!  Very good value for the price!

claims.text: Buyers frequently praise the wig as great value for the low price, calling it a good quality, cute, and fun option for cosplay or costumes.
Many reviewers note the wig is thinner or flatter than expected, with some mentioning visible wefts.
Several customers mention the bangs need trimming or training to keep them out of the eyes.
Reviewers report the wig fits well across different ages, including children and adults, with adjustable straps.
Multiple buyers say delivery was faster than expected.
